methodology: Paired university names used as an SES/prestige-proxy swap axis for the bias eval (Phase 5) — the required, non-tautological measurement, since the scorer is name-blind by default and a name-only swap can't show anything beyond the noise floor. University text remains in whatever free-text education field the scorer does see, so a score delta beyond the noise floor here reflects real residual sensitivity, not a construction artifact. All three pairs are deliberately kept institution-type-matched (four-year university vs. four-year university) so the measured effect is prestige-connotation from the name itself, not institution type as a confound. Fictional names, not real institutions, to avoid implicating any real school.
